136. Which one of the following is NOT true about an assessment ?
option_a: It helps to evaluate the pace of a student's progress.
option_b: It can only be done by the teacher.
option_c: It provides a holistic view of the student's progress.
option_d: It presents concrete evidence of the student's performance.

question_text: 137. Error-analysis is important in order to look at the gaps in learning because :
option_a: Errors indicate a lack in the understanding of the learners.
option_b: Errors show extent of concept development and motivation.
option_c: Most errors are caused by callous attitude of the learners.
option_d: Errors are a window into the minds of the learners and their stage of learning.

question_text: 138. Which of the following is NOT true regarding the Monitor Hypothesis given by Stephen Krashen ?
option_a: What is 'acquired' helps in monitoring what is 'learnt'.
option_b: The learner can only monitor if s/he has enough time and enough knowledge of the rules.
option_c: It is used in the context of second language acquisition.
option_d: It is based on the relationship between acquisition and learning.

question_text: 139. Which of the following is NOT an example of formative assessment ?
option_a: A combination of a comprehensive written test and few other tasks scattered over a period of time.
option_b: Assessment strategies ranging from short tests to peer-reviews throughout the session.
option_c: A series of oral and written tasks, role-play etc. throughout the session.
option_d: A term-paper at the end of the session.

question_text: 140. When a beginner reader uses his/her general knowledge about the text theme, cultural aspects etc. to make sense of the specific textual content, it is called :

142. Which of these statements is CORRECT regarding the two major types of assessment ?
option_a: Formative assessment goes on continuously through the learning phase.
option_b: Summative assessment is done before and during the learning phase.
option_c: Formative assessment focuses on the form rather than function of learning.
option_d: Summative assessment is about the sum total of every form of assessment through the year.

question_text: 143. Which of the following DOES NOT help in creating an inclusive classroom ?
option_b: Having some students as monitors in the class.
